discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of the primordial density fluctuations
motivation: Inflation transformed cosmology from a description of initial conditions into a dynamical, predictive science. Guth recognized that an early epoch of accelerated expansion solves the horizon, flatness and monopole problems; Linde made the idea viable through new and chaotic inflation, showing how a slowly rolling scalar field naturally ends inflation and reheats the universe. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations, stretched to cosmic scales, seed all structure, predicting a nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian spectrum with a small red tilt. These predictions have been confirmed with stunning precision by COBE, WMAP, Planck and ground-based CMB experiments, including the measured tilt n_s of about 0.965 and superhorizon acoustic correlations. The galaxies we see are quantum fluctuations made visible on the sky: the most dramatic union of quantum mechanics and gravity ever observed, and a direct window onto physics at energies far beyond any collider.
